title: Planning a dinner party
instructions: Jess ve Tom akşam yemeği daveti planlıyor. Uzun bir diyalog; misafir sayısı, yemek seçimi ve görev dağılımını takip et.

script.speaker: jess
script.text: Let's have a dinner party next Saturday. We haven't seen our friends for ages.

script.speaker: tom
script.text: Good idea. Who shall we invite?

script.speaker: jess
script.text: Sara and Paul, and Ahmet and his wife. So six people with us.

script.speaker: tom
script.text: Our table is only for four, but we can borrow chairs from my brother.

script.speaker: jess
script.text: Great. What shall we cook? I was thinking of roast beef.

script.speaker: tom
script.text: Paul doesn't eat meat. He's vegetarian.

script.speaker: jess
script.text: Oh, I forgot. Then let's make a big vegetable lasagne. Everybody likes that.

script.speaker: jess
script.text: Sara said she wants to bring a cake. She makes amazing cakes.

script.speaker: tom
script.text: Perfect. I'll do the shopping on Friday.

script.speaker: jess
script.text: And I'll cook. Can you clean the flat?

script.speaker: tom
script.text: Sure. What time shall we tell them?

questions.prompt: How many people will be at the dinner?
questions.feedback: İki çift ve kendileri: altı kişi.

questions.prompt: Why don't they cook roast beef?

questions.evidence: Sara said she wants to bring a cake.

questions.prompt: What is Tom going to do?
options: do the shopping and clean the flat
questions.feedback: Tom cuma alışveriş yapacak ve evi temizleyecek; yemeği Jess pişirecek.
questions.evidence: I'll do the shopping on Friday.
